description_en: Sends an interactive downlink 5G message to reply to a user's uplink message
description_zh: 发送交互下行的5G消息，回复用户的上行消息
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi send-rcs-reply --in-reply-to-rcs-id 100000096034031_1552101_03304904325170151776946304855 --sign-name '阿里云5G消息' --template-code RCS_SMS_10001052 --phone-numbers 13500001234 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendRCSReply

parameters.help_en: The target RcsID to reply to. This can only be set to the rcs_id of a user's uplink message. It cannot be set to the ID of a downlink message
parameters.help_zh: 回复的目标RcsID。只能填写用户上行消息的rcs_id，不能填写下行消息的ID
parameters.name: in_reply_to_rcs_id

parameters.help_en: The template parameters. Specify the value in JSON format, such as {"username":"John","account":"1001112"}
parameters.name: template_param

parameters.help_en: The external serial number extension field. This field is included in the receipt message
parameters.help_zh: 外部流水扩展字段，在回执报文中会携带
parameters.name: out_id
